basis: Childhood carcinoids arise predominantly in the appendix/GI tract. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish an endocrine-gland or metabolic disorder.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: neuroendocrine lineage alone does not establish disease of an endocrine gland or a metabolic disorder.

basis: Microphthalmia defines the disorder. Polydactyly occurs in 1/3, but associated musculoskeletal damage or functional impairment is not established.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: polydactyly in 1/3 meets the frequency threshold, but an additional digit alone does not establish musculoskeletal damage or loss of function.

basis: The Glasgow variant combines lethal skeletal dysplasia with characteristic cataracts and anemia; hepatosplenomegaly alone does not establish hepatic dysfunction.

decisions.haematologic: primary: anemia is a characteristic component distinguishing the Glasgow variant, rather than a minority complication of ordinary thanatophoric dysplasia.
decisions.ocular: primary: cataracts are a characteristic defining component of the Glasgow variant.

basis: Retinal degeneration with early deafness is the established syndromic phenotype. Respiratory ciliary disease is variant-dependent; its frequency across the umbrella is unestablished.

decisions.pulmonary: none: primary ciliary dyskinesia is an alternative variant-associated presentation; common airway involvement across this umbrella is not established.
decisions.otologic: primary: early-onset deafness is a defining component of the established retinal-deafness phenotype represented by the named child concept.

basis: Vitamin deficiency with retinal dysfunction, night blindness and xerophthalmia explicitly included in its definition and cardinal clinical manifestations.

decisions.ocular: primary: night blindness and xerophthalmia are cardinal defining manifestations explicitly included in the disease definition.

basis: Schwann-cell nerve tumor; hearing dysfunction is HPO frequent (30-79%). The scleral annotation represents a rare tumor location and is not credible as an umbrella frequency.

decisions.otologic: involved: hearing dysfunction is annotated frequent (30-79%), supporting substantial auditory loss from vestibular nerve tumors.

basis: Immune-mediated fascial inflammation with defining cutaneous/subcutaneous induration and fibrosis. Reactive eosinophilia does not establish a blood disorder.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: progressive skin/subcutaneous induration and disabling cutaneous fibrosis are defining clinical features of eosinophilic fasciitis.

basis: Anemia due to enzyme dysfunction encompasses erythrocyte metabolic disorders; metabolic disease need not affect multiple organs to qualify.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the represented erythrocyte enzymopathies are disorders of cellular metabolism; a systemic metabolic phenotype is not required.

basis: Ceramide metabolic leukodystrophy; optic disc pallor and neurogenic bladder each 2/2. Joint contractures (2/2) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.renal: involved: neurogenic bladder in 2/2 establishes loss of bladder function as part of the disorder; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none at cap: joint contractures occur in 2/2, but ocular and bladder dysfunction take priority alongside the two defining primary axes.

basis: Brittle, sparse hair and intellectual disability characterize Sabinas syndrome; intellectual disability is a defining component despite unspecified HPO frequency.

decisions.neurologic: primary: intellectual disability is a characteristic defining component of Sabinas syndrome, rather than an incidental or minority complication.
